module origen_146668 (
    input wire BUS_CLK,
    input wire BUS_RST,
    input wire [31:0] BUS_ADD,
    inout wire [31:0] BUS_DATA,
    input wire BUS_RD,
    input wire BUS_WR,
    input wire SEQ_CLK,
    input wire SEQ_IN,
    input wire SEQ_EXT_START
);

    // Parameters
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam WRITE = 2'b01;
    localparam READ = 2'b10;

    // Internal registers
    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [31:0] mem_addr;
    reg [31:0] data_reg;
    reg [31:0] write_data;
    reg write_enable;
    reg read_enable;

    // Bidirectional data bus
    assign BUS_DATA = (state == READ && read_enable) ? data_reg : 32'bz;

    // State machine
    always @(posedge BUS_CLK or posedge BUS_RST) begin
        if (BUS_RST) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            mem_addr <= 32'b0;
            data_reg <= 32'b0;
            write_enable <= 1'b0;
            read_enable <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (BUS_WR) begin
                        state <= WRITE;
                        mem_addr <= BUS_ADD;
                        write_data <= BUS_DATA;
                        write_enable <= 1'b1;
                    end else if (BUS_RD) begin
                        state <= READ;
                        mem_addr <= BUS_ADD;
                        read_enable <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
                WRITE: begin
                    write_enable <= 1'b0;
                    state <= IDLE;
                end
                READ: begin
                    read_enable <= 1'b0;
                    state <= IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

    // Memory interface
    reg [31:0] memory [0:1023];

    always @(posedge BUS_CLK) begin
        if (write_enable) begin
            memory[mem_addr] <= write_data;
        end
        if (read_enable) begin
            data_reg <= memory[mem_addr];
        end
    end

    // Sequence recording logic
    reg [31:0] seq_data;
    reg [9:0] seq_addr;
    reg seq_write_enable;

    always @(posedge SEQ_CLK or posedge BUS_RST) begin
        if (BUS_RST) begin
            seq_data <= 32'b0;
            seq_addr <= 10'b0;
            seq_write_enable <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (SEQ_EXT_START) begin
                seq_addr <= 10'b0;
                seq_write_enable <= 1'b1;
            end

            if (seq_write_enable) begin
                seq_data <= {seq_data[30:0], SEQ_IN};
                
                if (seq_addr[4:0] == 5'b11111) begin
                    memory[seq_addr[9:5]] <= seq_data;
                end

                seq_addr <= seq_addr + 1'b1;

                if (seq_addr == 10'h3FF) begin
                    seq_write_enable <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
